headline: Marcopolo Posts 43% Drop in Third-Quarter Profit
summary: Brazilian bus manufacturer Marcopolo reported a 43% decline in third-quarter profit to 186.5 million reals, disappointing market expectations.
why: Earnings reports provide key insights into corporate profitability and manufacturing demand trends across cyclical industrial sectors.

impacts.name: Marcopolo
impacts.why: Lower quarterly earnings directly reduce corporate profitability figures, impacting share valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A sharp drop in net profit relative to market consensus led to selling pressure on the company's shares.
